tools.name: via_list_services
tools.description: Free VIA service discovery. Lists HTTP services and advertised prices; does not run research, charge, sign or purchase.

tools.name: via_get_service
tools.description: Free integration instructions for one VIA HTTP service: exact endpoint, JSON input schema, example and x402 payment steps. Does not execute the service or authorize payment.

tools.name: via_extract_web_lite
tools.description: Web Text Lite: extract clean text, title and headings from a public HTML or plain-text page (up to 1 MiB, max 10000 characters; no PDF, OCR, JavaScript rendering or links) for 0.001 USDC on Base via x402. PDF URLs are refused before payment; use via_extract_page (0.02 USDC) for PDFs. Nothing is char

tools.name: via_extract_page
tools.description: Extract structured text from a public web page or PDF for 0.02 USDC on Base via x402. Payment is only made after buyer approval.

tools.name: via_api_compare

tools.name: via_one_call_quote
tools.description: Free quote for the VIA toll: VIA-owned delivery first, eligible paid supplier otherwise. Returns supplier cost, VIA margin and total. No wallet signature or payment. Continue only if ok and executionEnabled are true.

tools.name: via_one_call
tools.description: Execute a VIA toll operation through the existing One-Call payment and delivery handler. First call without payment returns the live x402 offer; only after buyer approval, retry IDENTICAL task, maxUsdc and private orderId with the buyer-signed payload in params._meta['x402/payment']. Buyer pays VIA

tools.name: via_one_call_status
tools.description: Free status/recovery lookup for an external Transit order using its private UUIDv4. Never submits payment. Does not cover VIA-owned service receipts; 404 is not proof that a payment did not occur.
